info.description: Converts videos into block-color delta data and outputs an add-on with audio that you can import (.mcaddon = Behavior Pack + Resource Pack). Multiple videos can be packed together.

wizard.fix.ai_anime: The anime person cutout is not available. All other display modes work.

after.guide:
How to play:
1. Press “Import into Minecraft” or double-click {output} to import it into Minecraft.
2. Create a new world, turn on Cheats, and activate this add-on under both Behavior Packs and Resource Packs (a superflat world works best).
3. Enter the world and type these commands in chat:
{commands}
4. Use a compass to open the remote (play, pause, switch videos).
